sections.h2: What should an Eastpointe homeowner know before selling?
sections.html:
Eastpointe is a small, dense Macomb County city of 5.16 square miles, and most of what sellers deal with is rental registration, tax billing and school boundaries rather than a pre-sale inspection. Roughly 70 percent of homes are owner-occupied, so many buyers are families looking for a first or second home.

The community was first settled by Irish and German immigrants in the 1830s. A post office opened in October 1897 under the name Half-way, because the spot sat near the halfway point of the stage run between downtown Detroit and the county seat at Mount Clemens. It became the village of Halfway in 1924 and the city of East Detroit in 1929. Voters approved the name Eastpointe in a 1992 referendum, partly to separate the city's identity from Detroit and to echo the nearby Grosse Pointes.

Eastpointe sits ten miles northeast of downtown Detroit. Warren lies to the west, Roseville to the north and St. Clair Shores to the east, and 8 Mile Road forms the southern edge beside Detroit and Harper Woods.

sections.h2: How does Eastpointe housing look in the Census figures?
sections.html:
The city peaked at 45,920 residents in 1970, slipped to 32,442 by 2010 and has hovered near 34,000 since. The numbers below come from the Census Bureau's QuickFacts for the city.

Eastpointe city snapshot, Census Bureau QuickFacts
MeasureEastpointe
Population estimate, July 1, 202533,814
Owner-occupied housing rate, 2020-202470.3%
Median value of owner-occupied homes$142,200
Median gross rent$1,325

Mean travel time to work26.4 minutes
Land area5.16 square miles

Median gross rent of $1,325 is close to what Dearborn renters pay, even though the median home value is far lower. Rents that high against modest home values make rented houses common, so the city's rental registration rules come up in many sales.

sections.h2: Do Eastpointe rental and vacant property rules affect a sale?
sections.html:
They can. The Building Department manages registration and inspection of every non-owner-occupied residential property, and tenants cannot occupy a rental until the city certifies it. If your house is rented, the buyer inherits that regime.

  • Rentals must be registered and inspected every two years from the application date.
  • If a property is certified at the time of sale, the certificate may transfer to the new owner when that owner registers within 14 days of purchase.
  • Owners and property managers complete a one-time registration separate from the property registration.
  • An owner who lives 50 miles or more from city hall must name a local agent.
  • A furnace or boiler must pass an inspection by a qualified contractor.

Vacant buildings have their own rule: register within 45 days of the vacancy, renew each year until the property is occupied again, and obtain a certificate of compliance for re-occupancy. Call the Building Department at 586-445-3661 for rentals (extension 2269) or vacant properties (extension 2214).

sections.h2: Which schools, roads and nearby colleges matter to Eastpointe buyers?
sections.html:
Eastpointe Community Schools serves most of the city. It was called East Detroit Public Schools until 2017 and runs one high school, one middle school and four elementary schools. The southeastern corner of the city belongs to South Lake Schools, and Koepsell Elementary of that district sits inside Eastpointe. Confirm the district for your address before listing, since it changes what an owner-occupant buyer will pay.

Gratiot Avenue (M-3) runs through the city, with I-94 and I-696 close by, and 8 Mile Road (M-102) and 9 Mile Road carry cross-town traffic. Macomb Community College's South Campus is two miles north in Warren, and the Wayne County Community College District's Mary Ellen Stempfle University Center is across 8 Mile Road in Harper Woods.

Local life centers on John F. Kennedy Memorial Park, the Cruisin' Gratiot car celebration in June and the late-July Erin-Halfway Days festival. The American Power Boat Association is headquartered in the city, and the first Art Van furniture showroom opened on Gratiot in 1959.

sections.h2: When are Eastpointe property taxes due?
sections.html:
The City Treasurer collects for the city, Macomb County, Macomb Community College, the intermediate school district, the state education tax and both school districts. About 30,000 bills go out each year, and both school districts ask that 100 percent of school tax appear on the summer bill.

  • Summer taxes are due July 1 with a September 1 deadline. They can be paid in full by September 1, or half by September 1 and half by December 1.
  • Winter taxes are due December 1 with a February 15 deadline.
  • Late summer taxes add 1 percent a month after September 1, and a further 2 percent from February 16.
  • Unpaid winter taxes add 3 percent from February 16.
  • From March 1, unpaid taxes go to the Macomb County Treasurer at One South Main Street in Mount Clemens, with added penalties.

Eligible owners can defer summer taxes to February 15 if household income is $40,000 or less and they are 62 or older, disabled, a qualifying veteran, a surviving spouse or blind. The deferment application is due by September 15. For a payoff figure, call the taxes line at 586-445-3661, option 6.

sections.h2: What paperwork does the Eastpointe assessor handle after a sale?
sections.html:
Eastpointe's Assessing Department explains the sequence in plain terms. The buyer signs the principal residence exemption form at closing if the house will be owner-occupied. The seller signs a request to rescind the exemption and files it with the assessor, which clears the seller's name from the homestead and lets the seller claim it on the next home.

The buyer must file a Property Transfer Affidavit within 45 days. Late filing carries a penalty of $5 per day up to $200. The taxable value is uncapped the year after a transfer, so the new owner's bill rises to match the assessed value, which the city sets at half of market value.

Value disputes go to the March Board of Review. The July and December boards hear only clerical errors, mutual mistakes of fact and poverty requests, and a residential appeal to the Michigan Tax Tribunal is due by June 30.

sections.h2: What state transfer taxes apply to an Eastpointe sale?
sections.html:
The seller pays the state transfer tax of $3.75 per $500 of value (MCL 207.525) and a county tax of 55 cents per $500 in a county with fewer than 2,000,000 residents (MCL 207.504). Ask the Macomb County Register of Deeds for the current figure at 586-469-7953. Payment is due to the county treasurer within 15 days after delivery of the deed.

Exemptions in MCL 207.526 include transfers to a child or grandchild, deeds in lieu of foreclosure, and land contracts where the title has not passed. A land contract buyer can still claim the principal residence exemption if the contract is recorded or recordable.

faqs.q: Does Eastpointe require an inspection before I sell my house?
faqs.a: The city's published rules cover rental registration and vacant property registration, not a general pre-sale inspection. If the house is a rental, the certificate may pass to the buyer if the buyer registers within 14 days. Call the Building Department to confirm your property's status.

faqs.q: When are Eastpointe summer and winter taxes due?
faqs.a: Summer taxes are due July 1 with a September 1 deadline, and winter taxes are due December 1 with a February 15 deadline. Unpaid balances go to the Macomb County Treasurer starting March 1.

faqs.q: How do I remove my principal residence exemption after selling?
faqs.a: Sign a request to rescind the exemption and file it with the Eastpointe Assessing Department. That clears your name from the homestead so you can claim the exemption on your next home.

faqs.q: What does the buyer file after an Eastpointe closing?
faqs.a: A Property Transfer Affidavit, within 45 days of the transfer, filed with the Assessor's Office. The closing agent usually supplies the form, but the buyer is responsible for filing it, and late filing costs $5 per day up to $200.

faqs.q: Which school district is my Eastpointe house in?
faqs.a: Most of the city is in Eastpointe Community Schools, and the southeastern corner is in South Lake Schools. Check the district for your exact address before you list.
